Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Group R10-RCA-FRICTION, topic r10-rca-harness-friction. Read your roster group: `git show origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster:dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json | jq '.groups[]|select(.group=="R10-RCA-FRICTION")'`; read dev/governance/roles/root-cause.md and dev/governance/rules/defect-root-cause.md (the four products an RCA owes), dev/governance/roles/fixer.md, dev/governance/rules/finding-propagation.md, and the INSTRUMENTS.md entries for body_push.sh, prepr.sh and fold_ledger.py.

It is 905 commits behind main and conflicts in dev/audit/config/bugclasses.json and dev/governance/roles/orchestrator.md; it also edits dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and orchestrator.md (policy). Decision 0012's moratorium (to 2026-10-31) allows editing existing policy files but adds no policy file, lint class or .claude/rules entry.

Bring it onto current main: `git merge origin/main` into the old tip (never rebase, never force). Union both sides in bugclasses.json and orchestrator.md, never dropping main's newer text, and prove each side's clauses are present by reading the merged file. Re-check every RCA record against the four products (named cause, process state a-d with evidence, cost test with numbers, countermeasure or recorded refusal); re-verify every figure at current main instead of carrying it. `tools/audit/fold_ledger.py check` must pass. Every Forward-carry/Friction line ends `Carry: <GROUP>|#<issue>|dismissed: <reason>` with a destination that exists. Run the scoped gate (fixer.md step 5), `python3 tests/structure.py` and `tools/audit/seat/prepr.sh` on the body before the handoff. Hand off code to handoff/r10-rca-harness-friction (fast-forward) and BODY.md via tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh to handoff-body/r10-rca-harness-friction.

Toolchain: this environment may lack the pinned toolchain. If `command -v seat-python` and `/opt/hpo/venv-ci/bin/python` are both absent, run `bash tools/audit/seat/cloud-setup.sh` yourself first (read its header), then put its venv bin and tools/audit/seat/shims first on PATH; if it cannot build, report that and run what you can with the system python3.
